Layout updatemenu objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_updatemenu.Rd

Properties of layout.updatemenu.

Usage

go_layout_updatemenu(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  active = NULL,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  bordercolor = NULL,
  borderwidth = NULL,
  buttons = NULL,
  direction = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  pad = NULL,
  showactive = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  type = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  xanchor = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  yanchor = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_updatemenu_button(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  args = NULL,
  args2 = NULL,
  execute = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  method = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_updatemenu_font(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  lineposition = NULL,
  shadow = NULL,
  size = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  textcase = NULL,
  variant = NULL,
  weight = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_updatemenu_pad(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  b = NULL,
  l = NULL,
  r = NULL,
  t = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

active

Determines which button (by index starting from 0) is considered active. Integer in the interval [-1, Inf].

bgcolor

Sets the background color of the update menu buttons. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

bordercolor

Sets the color of the border enclosing the update menu. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

borderwidth

Sets the width (in px) of the border enclosing the update menu. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

buttons

List of named lists or go_layout_updatemenu_button() objects.

direction

Determines the direction in which the buttons are laid out, whether in a dropdown menu or a row/column of buttons. For `left` and `up`, the buttons will still appear in left-to-right or top-to-bottom order respectively. One of "left", "right", "up", "down".

font

Sets the font of the update menu button text. Named list or go_layout_updatemenu_font() object.

name

When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

pad

Sets the padding around the buttons or dropdown menu. Named list or go_layout_updatemenu_pad() object.

showactive

Highlights active dropdown item or active button if true. Logical.

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

type

Determines whether the buttons are accessible via a dropdown menu or whether the buttons are stacked horizontally or vertically One of "dropdown", "buttons".

visible

go_layout_updatemenu(): Determines whether or not the update menu is visible. Logical.

go_layout_updatemenu_button(): Determines whether or not this button is visible. Logical.

x

Sets the x position (in normalized coordinates) of the update menu. Number in the interval [-2, 3].

xanchor

Sets the update menu's horizontal position anchor. This anchor binds the `x` position to the "left", "center" or "right" of the range selector. One of "auto", "left", "center", "right".

y

Sets the y position (in normalized coordinates) of the update menu. Number in the interval [-2, 3].

yanchor

Sets the update menu's vertical position anchor This anchor binds the `y` position to the "top", "middle" or "bottom" of the range selector. One of "auto", "top", "middle", "bottom".

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

args

Sets the arguments values to be passed to the Plotly method set in `method` on click. Vector or list of up to 3 element(s).

args2

Sets a 2nd set of `args`, these arguments values are passed to the Plotly method set in `method` when clicking this button while in the active state. Use this to create toggle buttons. Vector or list of up to 3 element(s).

execute

When true, the API method is executed. When false, all other behaviors are the same and command execution is skipped. This may be useful when hooking into, for example, the `plotly_buttonclicked` method and executing the API command manually without losing the benefit of the updatemenu automatically binding to the state of the plot through the specification of `method` and `args`. Logical.

label

Sets the text label to appear on the button. String.

method

Sets the Plotly method to be called on click. If the `skip` method is used, the API updatemenu will function as normal but will perform no API calls and will not bind automatically to state updates. This may be used to create a component interface and attach to updatemenu events manually via JavaScript. One of "restyle", "relayout", "animate", "update", "skip".

color

Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

family

HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

lineposition

Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none".

shadow

Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String.

size

Number in the interval [1, Inf].

style

Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

textcase

Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower".

variant

Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase".

weight

Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

b

The amount of padding (in px) along the bottom of the component. Number.

l

The amount of padding (in px) on the left side of the component. Number.

r

The amount of padding (in px) on the right side of the component. Number.

t

The amount of padding (in px) along the top of the component. Number.

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_updatemenu() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

Nested objects documented here:

go_layout_updatemenu_button()

layout.updatemenu.button

go_layout_updatemenu_font()

layout.updatemenu.font: Sets the font of the update menu button text.

go_layout_updatemenu_pad()

layout.updatemenu.pad: Sets the padding around the buttons or dropdown menu.

See also

go_layout()
